description: Fields of a work claim (decision D33), cycles/<cycle>/claims/<scope>.json on the state branch. Built by package M2 when the build widens; not read on the thin slice path. The object stays open: a later version may add a field, and an older reader must not fail on it.

scope.description: The id of a row of tables/work-claim-scopes.toml: story.<id>, cycle, spec, open or open.hotfix. It equals the file's stem.

cycle.description: The cycle the file lies under; _standing for spec, open, open.hotfix and standing work.

workflow.description: The workflow of the run that took the claim.

subject.description: That run's subject, for example the wave a cycle claim is driving; empty when it has none.

holder.description: Who holds the claim: the person as git would stamp a commit made in the holder's clone, and the clone.

clone.description: The id in the holder's clone record.

label.description: The label in the holder's clone record. Shown to people beside the id; no program decides anything by it.

run.description: The run that took the claim, or entered it last. It names a run record on the holder's clone only. Empty when no run took it: a person took it over with vsdd claim take, or the clone claimed what it had in flight when it joined the team.

at.description: ISO 8601, UTC, by the holder's clock. Shown to people; no program compares it with another clone's time.

plugin.description: The plugin version that wrote the claim.

taken_from.description: Present after vsdd claim take: the holder the claim was taken from, as the record named them, and the note the person gave.
